<thought>All peaks between ~110 ppm and ~160 ppm correspond to aromatic carbons. The spectrum shows peaks at 137.56 ppm (2), 131.90 ppm (2), 130.00 ppm (4), and 128.40 ppm (4), totaling 12 aromatic carbon signals. This matches the expected count for a molecule with a carbonyl carbon (196.40 ppm) plus a biphenyl‑type aromatic system. Therefore, the molecule contains 12 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
